lines.en: I trot along the branch.

lines.zh: 我抱着尾巴，从这枝跳到那枝。
lines.en: Hugging my tail, I leap branch to branch.
I spiral once around the trunk.
I stop and look below.
The bark whispers under my feet.
I leap to the next tree.
My claws dig into the bark.
I trot along the wall top.
I run while glancing up.
My tail keeps me balanced.

lines.zh: 我从一根枝荡到另一根。
lines.en: I swing from one branch to another.
I round the trunk and vanish.
I cross a stretch of fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 我尾巴一摆，藏了颗绿宝石。
lines.en: One flick of my tail conceals an emerald.
My steps are quick and light.
I circle half around a low branch.
I crouch on the branch, tail curled.
I'm gnawing a nut.
My eyes keep darting.
I stash the nut in a hollow.

lines.zh: 尾巴一扫，树皮屑落下来。
lines.en: A flick of my tail drops bark flakes.
I listen to the ground below.
I flatten out along the branch.

lines.zh: 我提起一只后腿又放下。
lines.en: I lift a hind leg and set it down.
I'm grinding my front teeth.

lines.zh: 我往下看了一眼，又缩回。
lines.en: I glance down, then pull back.

lines.zh: 我毛里藏着宝石的碎光。
lines.en: Jewel glints hide in my fur.
I drape my tail over my head.
A bird calls; I ignore it.

lines.zh: 我蹲在树杈上，眼睛半眯。
lines.en: I squat in the fork, eyes half shut.

lines.zh: 我把一颗坚果塞进颊囊。
lines.en: I stuff a nut into my cheek pouch.
I've been up here a while.
You're looking up from below.
I crouch on the branch and watch you.
Are you coming up?
Your hand can't reach up here.

lines.zh: 你靠近，我就往上爬一格。
lines.en: Come closer and I climb one notch higher.

lines.zh: 你身上有坚果的味道吗。
lines.en: Do you have nuts on you?
I tilt my head and study you.
This canopy is mine.

lines.zh: 你走近树干，我就往上爬。
lines.en: Come near the trunk and I'll climb higher.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，可我不想下来。
lines.en: I'm not afraid, but I won't come down.
I'm above your head.
That hat of yours looks good.
I nearly fell off the branch.
My tail has drooped.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，抱紧了尾巴。
lines.en: I squeak and clutch my tail.
I shrink into the hollow.

lines.zh: 我的爪子打滑，差点掉下去。
lines.en: My claws slip and I nearly fall.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴比身子还大，被撞歪了。
lines.en: My tail is bigger than my body, and it is knocked askew.
I climb a few feet higher.
I'm trembling on the branch.
That jolt left me numb.
I need another hollow.
Those are nuts, aren't they?
Is that a nut? Or a shiny stone?

lines.zh: 我从枝上往下挪了一段。
lines.en: I climb down a stretch.
That smell is close.
I'll look first, then come down.
You've opened your hand.
I creep a branch closer.
This much is worth hiding.
I grip the trunk and hang head down.
Hold still; I'm still looking.
This nut has a rich smell.
I hug the trunk and lean out.
I hold my tail up high.

lines.zh: 我藏了一颗紫水晶在洞里。
lines.en: I've an amethyst hidden in my burrow.
I'm only one branch away from you.
I reach out one forepaw.

lines.zh: 你撞到树干，我就在上面。
lines.en: You hit the trunk, and I'm above.

lines.zh: 宝石塞得我腮帮子鼓鼓的。
lines.en: The gems stuff my cheeks full.
I shoot upward and out of reach.
Don't shake the tree; I can't hold on.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，叶子落了一片。
lines.en: We collide and leaves fall.
You step on a fallen nut.
I slip to the other side of the trunk.
That nearly knocked me off.

lines.zh: 我在你肩膀那么高的枝上。
lines.en: I'm on a branch at your shoulder's height.
You raise a hand and I run higher.

lines.zh: 另一只落在旁边的枝上。
lines.en: Another lands on the branch beside me.
Nose touched nose once.
Its tail is longer than mine.
We crouch on the branch together.
It pushes a nut to me.
We gnaw the same one.
It leaps; I follow.
Our two tails twine.
On this fork we crowd together.

lines.zh: 地窖里的储藏，够我们俩。
lines.en: The hoard will keep us both.
I stuff the nut into my cheek.
I hug it with my forepaws.
Three are already stored in my hollow.
This is bright. Let me look.
It rolls off the branch; I chase.
This one I'll keep for winter.

lines.zh: 我把它卡在树皮的缝里。
lines.en: I wedge it into a crack in the bark.
This one's for my hoard.

lines.zh: 宝石松鼠，尾巴一卷就藏好。
lines.en: A jewel squirrel curls its tail and hides.
I push it into the hollow.
You shook my tree.
I snap my head up.
My tail has puffed out.
You've touched my hoard.
I retreat up the trunk.
You can't have that.

lines.zh: 你踩断树枝，我就知道了。
lines.en: You snap a twig; I already know.
This treetop belongs to me.
Come up and I'll drop down.

lines.zh: 我记住了你站的那棵树。
lines.en: I've noted which tree you stand under.
I follow you along the branches.
Turn left and I'm already there.
I watch you through the branches.
I weave through the canopy.
The canopy is thick; you can't count me.

lines.zh: 叶子一动，你就知道是我。
lines.en: A leaf stirs, and you know it's me.
I wait for your hand to reach up.

lines.zh: 这棵树的每根枝我都熟。
lines.en: I know every branch of this tree.
The higher you come, the better I run.

lines.zh: 我再绕一圈，宝石在树根下闪。
lines.en: One more circle; gems glint under the roots.
I drop at you from the branch.

lines.zh: 我掉的不是坚果，是宝石。
lines.en: What I drop isn't nuts. It's gems.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口就跑回树上。
lines.en: I nip once and bolt back up the tree.
You pull your hand back and I'm gone.

lines.zh: 我的爪子划过你的袖子。
lines.en: My claws rake your sleeve.
I bounce off your face.
You caught nothing.
I land on another branch.
I'm still above you.
Reach up again and see.

lines.zh: 树冠上传出一阵沙沙声。
lines.en: A rustle comes from the canopy.
Pinecone husks tumble from my hollow.

lines.zh: 这棵树上多了一只松鼠。
lines.en: One more squirrel in this tree.

lines.zh: 我沿着树干跑下来一点。
lines.en: I run a little way down the trunk.
I flick my tail and settle.
My hoard is still in the hollow.
I hop from a high branch to a low one.
Plenty of nuts here. I'll stay.
I raise my head and sniff the bark.
I settle in the fork of a branch.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的尾巴，我差点掉下去。
lines.en: Fire catches my tail and I nearly fall.

lines.zh: 我从枝上摔下来，砸在叶子上。
lines.en: I fall off the branch into the leaves.
Water up my nose and I flail.
The blast shakes me off the branch.
The arrow sticks in the trunk, inches away.

lines.zh: 法术让我的爪子抓不住。
lines.en: That spell takes the grip from my claws.
My hoard won't last the winter.

lines.zh: 雷劈中树冠，我的毛竖起来。
lines.en: Lightning hits the canopy; my fur stands up.
The void rips me off the tree.
